surface_verification.justification: Pure Python regex/logic change to review_record_tier.SENSITIVE_PATH_RE, a backend PR-gate decision helper with no UI, API route, or startable stack surface. Covered by unit tests (16 in test_review_record_tier.py, 993 passed in the full shipwright-security suite) and F0's diff-coverage gate. No client/** or server-consumed-by-UI code touched.

behaviors.behavior: an edit to the keystone AC gate's ci.yml-invoked entry point (check_keystone_ac_gate.py) forces mandatory review, matching an edit to ci.yml itself
an edit to any of the keystone gate's own _keystone_*.py verifier modules forces mandatory review
behaviors.evidence: plugins/shipwright-security/tests/test_review_record_tier.py::test_evidence_cannot_waive_without_a_trusted_label_or_on_sensitive_paths PASSED (assertions added for verifiers/_keystone_core.py and verifiers/_keystone_ac_digest.py)

behaviors.behavior: an unrelated verifier file outside the _keystone_ family (e.g. verifiers/common.py) stays waivable via skip-pr-review -- the new patterns are not over-broad
no existing SENSITIVE_PATH_RE alternative regressed (anchoring, other sensitive paths, waiver flow, CLI)
